accountId.title: Account Id
accountId.description: The customer account Id. Use currentRecordId when the user is on an Account record and says 'this customer' or 'my bill'.

accountName.title: Account Name
accountName.description: The customer name the user mentioned, for example Sam Patel.

invoiceNumber.title: Invoice Number
invoiceNumber.description: The invoice document number, for example DOC-000000016, if the user gave one.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The bill amount the user asked about, as a number without the dollar sign, for example 366.
